description: Sustantix AIP controlled vocabulary (phase 1). Canonical codes, observed aliases, column bindings and open owner decisions. Curated: edit by review, then run the schema generator.

tables.name: asset_class
tables.label: Asset class
tables.description: Physical asset classes; parent_code forms the class hierarchy.

tables.name: maintenance_type
tables.label: Maintenance type
tables.description: Maintenance strategy that triggered the work.

tables.name: priority
tables.label: Priority
tables.description: Urgency of work; rank 1 is the most urgent.

tables.name: severity
tables.label: Severity
tables.description: Impact rating shared by severity and criticality columns; rank 1 is the most severe.

tables.name: risk_band
tables.label: Risk band
tables.description: Composite asset risk band; rank 1 is the most severe. Watch sits between Medium and Low.

tables.name: status
tables.label: Status
tables.description: Lifecycle statuses, unique per entity scope. category: open, active, done or cancelled.

tables.name: unit
tables.label: Unit of measure
tables.description: Units with a dimension and a factor to the dimension's base unit (null where no fixed factor exists). CUR_* units take their currency from the row. Dimension parameter_type holds non-measurement parameter types until phase 2 moves them to the policy parameter type.

tables.name: currency
tables.label: Currency
tables.description: ISO-4217 currencies enabled for the platform; minor_units is the number of decimal places.

tables.name: region
tables.label: Region
tables.description: Countries and their subdivisions (codes follow ISO 3166), with tax regime, default currency and time zone. Tenants add subdivisions they operate in.

tables.name: failure_mode
tables.label: Failure mode
tables.description: Functional failure modes. Seeded with every observed mode; near-duplicates await the owner's merge decision.

tables.name: defect_code
tables.label: Defect and finding type
tables.description: PV module defect catalogue plus inspection finding types for other asset classes.

tables.name: skill
tables.label: Skill
tables.description: Technician competencies required by work and held by crews.

tables.name: event_type
tables.label: Event type
tables.description: Event classifications, unique per domain scope.

tables.name: source_system
tables.label: Source system
tables.description: Systems data originates from. Aliases record whether a value was demonstration, synthetic, illustrative or configured data.

tables.name: framework
tables.label: Reporting framework
tables.description: Sustainability disclosure frameworks that ESG metrics map to.

tables.name: emission_factor
tables.label: Emission factor
tables.description: Versioned emission factors. Tenant-governed: each tenant approves its own values; no platform defaults ship.

decisionsMade.decision: Electrical, Instrumentation, SCADA and Safety become asset classes (electrical balance of plant, instrumentation, SCADA system, safety system); Weather maps to Weather Station; Cleaning maps to PV Array, the asset cleaned. Delegated by the data owner.
Inventory-led is kept as a maintenance type (planned family): stock-driven replenishment work.
Watch ranks between Medium and Low.
'Demo - unverified' is provenance, not an operating state: correction C10 clears the status and records the flag in data basis.
Execution status is split in phase 3 into status, start timeliness and finish timeliness; the columns stay unbound until then.

Non-measurement values are coded as parameter types (dimension parameter_type) until phase 2 moves them to the policy parameter type; assets/cohorts counts as Count; L/recovered MWh is a separate basis from L/MWh.

True synonyms merged: Tracker drive mechanism fault → Tracker drive fault; Transformer insulation degradation → Insulation deterioration; Power-stage thermal degradation → IGBT thermal degradation. Degradation and failure stay distinct (Cooling fan degradation vs failure; Insulation deterioration vs failure) because they are different stages.
The column is a reliability reporting category, not a failure mode; it stays unbound and is renamed reliability_category in phase 2.
Cracked Module is glass damage; cell microcracks are recorded separately as cell cracking.
The column holds a skill for technicians, a tool category for tools and a vehicle type for vehicles; it stays unbound and is split by resource type in phase 2.
RCA event types are operational event types; five are added and Cooling-system deterioration is an alias of Cooling subsystem degradation.
Inverter preventive degradation control, Switchgear preventive inspection and Transformer defect response are kept as failure-mode codes: each names the failure the work addresses.
